plan.concept: Visualizing a 2D shear transformation along the y-axis, mapping the unit square to a sheared parallelogram with equations x' = x and y' = x + y
plan.layout: single panel coordinate plot showing a sheared 2D polygon

series.label: Sheared unit square
series.note: Filled polygon with vibrant orange background (#ff8000) and black border outline

plan.colorScheme: White background, sharp black axes with prominent arrowheads, vibrant orange fill (#ff8000) with thin black border for the transformed shape, black LaTeX-style serif typography.
plan.reconstructionNotes: Ensure the axes have explicit arrowheads at the positive ends (+x and +y). The sheared polygon represents the transformation of a [-1, 1]^2 square. Use a serif font (like Times New Roman or MathJax) for labels and equations to match the mathematical style of the source figure.
